'''Dorbus Kyrullus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who was dating the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Devidia Vennsiol]] by the time she finished [[Unidentified military school|military school]]. Together with his lover, Kyrullus broke into a [[Unidentified Safidine Industries laboratory|laboratory]] operated by [[Safidine Industries]], a weapons contractor for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. They stole a large number of prototype [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]] from the facility and escaped, but shortly afterwards Kyrullus was captured with the majority of the stolen arms. Vennsiol remained on the run alone and Safidine soon placed a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on her head.<ref name="BTDF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dorbus Kyrullus was created as part of the "[[Bounties to Die For]]" article in the [[Star Wars Gamer 6|sixth]] issue of [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' magazine series. The magazines were supplements for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' and Kyrullus was included in an entry for Devidia Vennsiol which was written by [[S. Mitch Ritchie]]. The article states only that the bounties are posted by the Empire but does not give a specific era in which they are set.<ref name="BTDF" />
